links.outcome: Accuracy (6-point) and completeness (3-point) of chatbot medication abortion answers versus NAF/RHAP/ACOG guidance
links.effect: ChatGPT median accuracy 5 (mean 5.26), completeness mean 2.57; Bard median accuracy 5 (mean 4.5), completeness mean 2.14; Bard gave no answer to 5 questions initially; no significant difference between chatbots.
links.quote: While both chatbots showed similar levels of accuracy, minor errors were noted, pertaining to finer aspects that demand specialized knowledge of abortion care.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and completeness of ChatGPT and Google Bard on medication abortion FAQs without testing a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
